title: Stratavault.ai — Private enterprise AI knowledge base with RAG and PII protection
content: Built Stratavault.ai: a private, secure AI knowledge base platform for organizations. Architecture: four layers — AI discovery agents that crawl networks, code repos, and live data feeds; vector database with PII obfuscation, semantic embeddings, and HNSW indexing; conversational LLM layer (Claude / GPT-4o) with source-grounded reasoning; and a code-token protection layer for credential and API key management. Stack: Python, ChromaDB, Streamlit, Fly.io. Live integrations pull from Azure, GitHub, and Meraki. Every answer is traceable to a source document. Zero-PII API calls — sensitive data is stripped before any LLM processing. Per-organization data isolation with role-based access control. White-label/reseller program for MSPs and vCIOs. Pricing: $499/month flat — no per-seat charges. Competes with Glean, Guru, and Microsoft Copilot for M365. Target markets: healthcare, finance, legal, nonprofits, field services.
outcome: Production enterprise AI knowledge base; white-label reseller channel; competes with Glean and Guru

title: AestheticIQ.ai — AI business intelligence SaaS for medical spas
content: Built AestheticIQ.ai: a vertical BI and analytics SaaS for medical spas and aesthetic practices running on Aesthetic Record (medspa practice management software). Transforms raw Aesthetic Record data into actionable dashboards via automated overnight sync. Stack: Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, cloud-hosted, AES-256 encryption, HIPAA compliant. Features: revenue analytics with trend lines, practitioner performance comparisons, service/product-level insights (top treatments, upsell opportunities), smart alerts for anomalies and milestones, multi-location support. No PHI exposed — aggregated business metrics only. 50+ medspa clients; 98% sync success rate. Setup in under 5 minutes. Pricing: $99–$199/month. This is a production AI-enhanced vertical SaaS built from scratch with a tight platform integration dependency and a real paying customer base.
outcome: 50+ paying medspa clients; production vertical BI SaaS; HIPAA compliant

title: AnalyzeMyCloud.com — AI-powered cloud cost optimization service
content: Built AnalyzeMyCloud.com: an AI-powered cloud cost analysis service for AWS, Azure, and GCP. Connects via read-only CLI access, scans infrastructure with AI trained on millions of dollars in cloud spending patterns, and delivers actionable savings recommendations within 24 hours. Key results: $2.1M+ in total client savings, 1,600+ optimized resources, average 35% cost reduction. Differentiators: automated VM hibernation (claims 70% savings on idle resources), real-time cost spike alerts, money-back guarantee (save 2x the $999 fee or full refund). One-time $999 analysis. Target: mid-to-large enterprises spending $5,000–$100,000+/month on cloud. This demonstrates AI applied to real infrastructure cost problems with measurable, quantifiable outcomes.
outcome: $2.1M+ in client savings; 35% average cloud cost reduction across 1,600+ resources

title: Upwork proposal style and tone preferences
content: Proposal style: direct, confident, specific — never flowery. Always includes: MBA credential, 25+ years enterprise experience, recent AI products (Stratavault.ai, AestheticIQ.ai, UpApply, AnalyzeMyCloud.com), 20+ years education SaaS platform, 160-server Azure migration, 3,000-client distributed SQL Server network, founding-to-scale narrative, demo prototype URL matching the job spec, no-cost/no-commitment call offer before the close. Never uses: Dear Hiring Manager, generic closings, clichés, sentences starting with I. Target length: 300-450 words. Ends with Warm regards,. Portfolio: servicevisionai.com and mvpcreator.servicevision.io.
